scope: Past expansion history under an already qualified native-CAMB corrected modern target; no independent galaxy clock or new likelihood.
derivative_method: Five-point local polynomial in dimensionless offsets: central at z>=2h, forward at z=0. Repeat at h/2. No evaluation at negative redshift.
scaled_error_definition: abs(recomputed-reference)/(1+abs(reference)); evaluated against both h/2 and stored native diagnostics.
posterior_rules: Require measurement_summary.summarize_run to pass all parent chain/weight/identity gates. Use original untrimmed exact/proposal weights. Recheck the existing weighted stability gates for the newly derived history. Pointwise intervals only; no simultaneous-band, evidence, future-extrapolation or Gaussian-sigma claim.
age_interpretation: Time since hot big bang in the assumed flat GR CMB model and fixed early-universe/neutrino physics; not an independent stellar-population age.
synthetic_numerical_amendment: Before any observational expansion-history output, a synthetic Lambda+radiation test found CAMB1.6.6 default physical_time/age Romberg tolerance1e-4 yields a0.00028147Gyr difference from converged quadrature. Report age using scipy adaptive quadrature of the unchanged CAMB H(a), cross-check256-node Gauss-Legendre after a=t^2, retain default-age difference. No scientific target or likelihood accuracy changes. Initial failed validation is preserved.
